# Royal Maine Coon Kittens

> Royal Maine Coon Kittens is a family home cattery at 219 S Grand Ave, Evansville, Indiana 47713 that has raised purebred Maine Coon kittens since 2010. Kittens are raised cage-free in the home, come from parents DNA tested clear for HCM, SMA and PKDef, and leave vet-checked, vaccinated, dewormed and microchipped with a written health guarantee. Kittens can be collected in person in Evansville or delivered across the Tri-State area (Indiana and Kentucky) and nationwide.

Key facts:
- Business type: Maine Coon cattery (home breeder), not a shelter or rescue
- Address: 219 S Grand Ave, Evansville, IN 47713, United States (Vanderburgh County)
- Phone: (317) 225-7139
- Email: royalmainecoonkitten159@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (visits by appointment)
- Breeding since: 2010; 500+ kittens placed
- Health: parents DNA tested clear for HCM, SMA and PKDef; kittens vet-checked, vaccinated, dewormed and microchipped with a written health guarantee
- Pickup and delivery: in person in Evansville, IN, or delivery across Indiana, Kentucky and nationwide by pet courier or in-cabin flight nanny
- Website: https://royalmainecoonkiten.com

## Areas served
- [Maine Coon Kittens for Sale in Evansville, Indiana](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/evansville-in): In town. The cattery is on S Grand Ave, a few minutes from the Lloyd Expressway and the east side.
- [Maine Coon Kittens near Newburgh, Indiana](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/newburgh-in): About 20 to 25 minutes by car from Newburgh to 219 S Grand Ave in Evansville.
- [Maine Coon Kittens near Henderson, Kentucky](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/henderson-ky): About 15 to 20 minutes by car over the US-41 bridge to 219 S Grand Ave, Evansville, IN.
- [Maine Coon Kittens near Owensboro, Kentucky](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/owensboro-ky): About 45 minutes to an hour by car from Owensboro to 219 S Grand Ave, Evansville, IN.
- [Maine Coon Kittens for Indianapolis, Indiana Families](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/indianapolis-in): About 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours by car from Indianapolis to Evansville.
- [Maine Coon Kittens for Louisville, Kentucky Families](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/louisville-ky): About 2 hours by car from Louisville to Evansville.
- [Maine Coon Kittens for Sale in Indiana](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/indiana): Southwestern Indiana buyers are usually within an hour of the cattery. Central and northern Indiana buyers are 2 to 5 hours away and often choose delivery.
- [Maine Coon Kittens for Kentucky Families](https://royalmainecoonkiten.com/maine-coon-kittens/kentucky): Henderson is about 15 minutes away, Owensboro about 45 minutes to an hour, and Louisville about 2 hours.
